title: Agent-demo inventory of a large Joomla site finishes inside its 90 s cap with the same records, and a build's step budget grows with its template
steps: S1: Read a fake Joomla site of 60 records per kind with a component that sends bodies and relation dumps, and the same site with one that sends neither; compare the inventories and count the Apply calls.
S2: Read a 200-record site whose answers arrive with jitter; record the most calls in flight and the record order.
S3: Refuse one content.get on a 300-record site; count the calls sent after the refusal.
S4: Ask loopNotices for builds of 40/10, 300/60 and 7800/400 records/rows after 55, 75, 115, 125 looking steps and 250, 485 steps of repairs.
expect: S1: records, hash and invariantHash identical; the bulk read makes fewer than 30 calls and no relation content.get.
S2: more than one and at most 8 calls in flight; same record keys, coverage and hash as the calm read.
S3: at most 8 calls after the refusal.
S4: a small build keeps five times the bars, a 300/60 build has room past 55 looking and 250 steps, the cap holds at 120 looking and 480 steps.
evidence: Local stand 24/10/2026: reverb-asian-fusion-res (Tracy Business j6, 7,787 records) hit AGENT_DEMO_INVENTORY_LIMIT at 90 s after 284 calls; after the fix 42 s, 341 calls, complete.
fence: createAgentDemoInventory (Apply reads only) and buildScale/loopNotices in tracy-site-tools; no stand, no model
